I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

I told him Pree first posted Dock 23 on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day after reading the wrong line. Both of her messages are in #central-team, and Hollis is a member of that channel.
